dsh.config.url: Base URL of the DSH harness this extension talks to. Default 3080 = the web GUI's harness: the extension connects as a shared client and never starts or kills it. If nothing answers there, the extension auto-starts its own instance (recorded in %TEMP%\dsh-vsc-harness.pid, stopped when VS Code exits) with the runtime overlay that bypasses dsh 0.1.7's launch-token auth. Also honors DSH_WEB_URL.
dsh.config.autoStart: Start `dsh web` automatically when no harness is reachable at the configured URL.
dsh.config.followAgentEdits: When DSH edits files, open them in the editor automatically with the cursor at the first changed line (preview tab, no focus steal, live refresh from disk). Covers direct write/edit tools and nested calls inside code execution (tools.write/edit etc.); shell commands without a recognizable path (e.g. pwsh Set-Content) are not tracked.
dsh.config.autoFixWorkspaceAcl: On opening or switching a workspace, automatically repair the folder permissions DSH's workspace-write sandbox needs (grants the current user full control); when it cannot, offers a one-time elevated fix. When disabled, the sandbox fails to start in workspaces with incomplete permissions (e.g. folders copied from another machine).
